correctness.rationale: For every within-step pair, the exact 2x2 map has M^T M=g I with strictly positive g. Any fixed-uniform 2x2 joint law has a single parameter q. Independence across steps implies the exact n-step expectation; the strong law implies the log gain. Two factorizations and verified root comparisons establish all thresholds and endpoints, including the 1/5 strict disagreement. All needed algebra is in the proof and reproduced by standalone source.

value.rationale: Two legitimate fixed-cost sampling policies are provably ordered oppositely by finite-horizon expected squared error and almost-sure exponential contraction, and the optimal coupling sharply enlarges the mean-square-stable stepsize region from 5/17 (reused) or 8/25 (independent) to 3/8. This makes an exact benchmark for the dependence structure of stochastic two-call optimization, not an arbitrary polynomial curiosity.
